title: madhuca costulata
intro: Madhuca costulata, commonly known as the Butterscotch Tree, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of India. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Madhuca costulata include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
